Name: Seasonal Outfits - Non-smoking Sebastian Sprite
Author: antisykotic
Description:
This mod is a slight tweak for Poltergeister's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url].

It changes Sebastian's sprite specifically the Sebastian smoking part to﻿﻿ Sebastian playing a handheld video game (based on Prismuth's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1643]Non-smoking Sebastian[/url]).

[u][b]﻿INSTRUCTIONS:[/b][/u]
1. Extract the contents of the zip file
2. Take the [b]Sebastian [/b]folder and replace the one in [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters\assets\Characters[/b].

[b][u]Optional[/u][/b]
If you want the character dialogues regarding Sebastian's smoking to be removed, I recommend downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2060?tab=files&file_id=11122]Mal's Sebastian Expansion - Non-smoking[/url].
If you already have this mod, please do the following to prevent the mods from clashing.

1. Open the content.json in the mod folder using notepad
2. Erase the following:
[code]﻿//changes seb's smoking sprite into a gaming sprite, curtesy of Prismuth
{
"Action": "Load",
"Target": "Characters/Sebastian",
"FromFile": "assets/Sebastian.xnb"
},
//removes reference to seb smoking
[/code]3. Save the file

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b]
I did not make any of these mods, I'm just a perfectionist that like to tweak around codes and stuff.
This mod will be taken down if Prismuth or Poltergeister wishes so.
